title: Run prompt
text: Trim and lock before asynchronous work.
explanation: React hooks keep prompt, mode, timeline and answer while lesson tabs change. A ref locks duplicate submissions immediately.

title: POST to Gin API
text: Send JSON to the browser-facing gateway.
explanation: Vite proxies /api locally; production Gin serves UI and API together. React has no model key or internal service token.

title: Validate public request
text: Check origin, media, actual bytes and prompt.
explanation: Gin bounds actual input to 32 KiB with MaxBytesReader and validates a trimmed 1–4000 character string before contacting Node. Raw invalid input is never echoed.

title: Authenticate private handoff
text: Attach the configured token to the fixed upstream request.
explanation: Only Gin adds the credential. It forwards normalized prompts under the browser request context; Node verifies the token with a timing-safe comparison.

title: Start real SDK runtime
text: Call the actual TypeScript Agent SDK.
explanation: Node owns the CLI and private model key. Each run has temporary work/home/config directories with tools, settings, skills, MCP, plugins and persistence disabled.

title: Exchange messages with Claude
explanation: The CLI-backed SDK owns provider HTTPS transport. This excerpt shows the application boundary rather than invented raw provider code.

title: Project safe SDK message
text: Select public text and lifecycle fields.
explanation: Thinking, private paths/session IDs and tool payloads are omitted. Key occurrences are redacted. These are SDK messages rather than token deltas.

title: Flush Node SSE response
text: Flush headers and await a backpressure-aware pipeline.
explanation: Closing the Gin upstream connection aborts the Node request signal and owned SDK controller.

title: Relay chunks through Gin
text: Write and flush each received SSE chunk.
explanation: Gin does not buffer the completed answer. Browser cancellation follows the Go context into the internal HTTP request. Node’s 180-second deadline is below Gin’s 185-second upstream context.

title: Normalize final result
explanation: Non-success SDK subtypes remain errors even if the raw flag is false. Unreported cost stays null.

title: Validate final result event
text: Require a typed result and done.
explanation: Malformed and truncated streams fail safely. The history cap does not stop final-result processing.

title: Render safe colored Markdown
explanation: Highlight.js colors code and DOMPurify removes active content before React HTML insertion. Go and TypeScript remain readable and copyable.

title: Complete result plus done
text: Complete transport after the SDK iterator.
explanation: Gin forwards done through the same stream. A final result is mandatory and done never overrides its error state.

title: Send safe stream failure
text: Relay a generic failure without done.
explanation: Gin relays the safe event. Raw provider diagnostics and credentials stay private. Deadline/disconnect cancellation clears timers and owned execution.

title: Show recoverable error
explanation: Cancel aborts fetch. Finally releases the lock and timer, while lesson navigation stays available.

title: Reject missing model key
explanation: Only Node loads the model key from agent-service/.env. Missing key returns query 503 or stream error without done through Gin.
